newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse eases in see-saw trading.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse eases in see-saw trading.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index eased a further 3.60 points to 3465.78 on Wednesday in see-saw trading, bourse officials said.
Volume rose to 44.786 million shillings on 1,243,401 shares from 36.609 million shillings on 803,875 shares on Tuesday.
"Today's trading largely lacked direction, which pushed prices down," a bourse official said.
Brokers said the increased turnover was boosted by a sale of East African Portland Cement shares on the three-day special board at a reserve price of 36 from 30.50.

They added that activity on the normal board was low mainly because there was a cloud of disappointment from the year-end results released by market-leading financials Barclays Bank and Standard Chartered Bank on Friday.
Barclays was unchanged at 111 while Standard eased to 49 from 50. Kenya Commercial Bank eased to 93 from 94 and National Bank of Kenya closed at 15.50 from 15.60.

"The market might stagnate at this level mostly because the rush by speculators is over now that the leading financials announced their results. Any significant trading will most probably occur on the special boards," a senior broker said.
Foreigners bought 64,200 shares of Uchumi Supermarket at 42 from 41 and 17,200 shares of Firestone East Africa at 31 from 32.25.
Sasini Tea & Coffee eased to 60.50 from 62 while Kenya Airways was unchanged at 8.70.
